hero: An isometric drawing in black, white and grey of Lumen at work on one platform. A folder of large photos at the back feeds a conveyor belt. The belt carries a large photo into the Lumen machine at the centre, a press with a terminal prompt on its side, and small photos with ticks come out the other end into a tray. Around the machine are a laptop running lumen in a terminal and cabled to the machine, the config file, a CI status tower with lit lights, a size gauge with bars that fall from left to right, and a cloud badge with an upload arrow for the CDN.
getting-started: An isometric drawing in black, white and grey of a first Lumen run. At the centre a laptop shows the install and compress commands in a terminal, with a tick on the last line. Around it are the Lumen binary in a taped package box with a terminal prompt on its label, a terminal card with a prompt, a folder of photos, the config file, a tray of compressed photos, and one finished photo standing on a foot with a round tick badge.
guides: An isometric drawing in black, white and grey of the Lumen guides. At the centre a bench vise squeezes a photo between its jaws, with arrows on the jaws that point at the photo. Around it are a photo with crop marks and a ruler for resizing, two standing format plates labelled WEBP and AVIF for converting, a stack of converted image files with an arrow, and a quality slider.
reference: An isometric drawing in black, white and grey of the Lumen reference. At the centre a card-catalog cabinet has one drawer pulled out to show its index cards, for the flags. Around it are a status tower whose display shows exit code 0 above five code lights, a stack of manuals, a small flag on a pole, a terminal card with a prompt for the commands, and the config sheet for the config fields.
edit-this-site: An isometric drawing in black, white and grey of this docs site in the ViteHub Console. At the centre a monitor shows the Content editor with a file tree, a page of text, a preview, and two comment pins. Around it are two databases, one marked with a person for users and one with a page for content, an open crate of photos and a video for media storage, a standing speech bubble, a page with a comment pin, and a plug in front of a socket for the MCP connection, cabled to the monitor.
